notes: Single panel. Gest (60') along the top from Wilder to past Depot. Wilder Av. (60') enters at the top edge from the NNE, crosses Glenway in a large open X junction and runs SSW to merge with Warsaw. Glenway: the north leg is printed only 'AV.' (sheet 465 labels it GLENWAY AV.), the leg from the junction to 8th is printed 'GLENWAY'; both recorded as Glenway Avenue. Warsaw Av. runs down the far left (west face partly off the left edge north of y 2000), merges with Wilder, crosses the Price Hill Inclined Plane R'y (ignored) with a short jog, then runs SE and turns south (40') onto sheet 461. Nevada (40') runs from Gest to a dead end at y about 3126. State Av. (60') crosses Gest and 8th. South and Dutton (50') run from State to Depot; South continues east of Depot onto 467, Dutton does not (Depot's east face unbroken). Depot is 60' north of South, 50' south of it. The bottom strip south of 8th shows State, Depot and the block between Glenway's line and State (sheet 462 overlaps). A 50 ft street printed 'PRICE' (PRICE HILL on 461, PRICE HILL ROAD on 465) shows only its east face along the bottom-left gutter (x 85-270, y 6980-7720); it meets nothing on this sheet. Small hatched bands at y about 3805 crossing the blocks between Warsaw, Wilder and Glenway are footbridges or trestles, not streets.
